Rina (CS): TritonAI asked for APAC (mumbai) enable + a short demo burst next Tue. Request: ap-south-1 pin, IPs 203.0.113.142/32 and 198.51.100.214/32, CORS https://demo.triton.ai, qps=500 for 2.5h (2026-04-13 15:00-17:30 IST). They also want a scoped demo key limited to model=v3-compact, retention=0, and HSM-backed token signing. Can infra/security confirm? @Pri @Bea @Olu
Shaan (TritonAI): Confirming. We'll run two simultaneous sessions with ~60 participants total, streaming enabled. Key must expire 4h after window and be restricted to generation only. Also prefer region pin with failover to ap-southeast-1.
Pri (Eng Infra): We can pin tenant=triton and create an ap-south-1 route with fallback to ap-southeast-1. For sustained 500 qps + streaming, recommend reserving 4x g4dn-equivalent nodes. I'll queue a reservation. Staging ACL update ready; need signed demo AUP for prod push.
Bea (SRE): Reserving 4 nodes now; autoscale policy min=4 max=6, scale trigger p95 latency>650ms for 3m. I'll add queue/conn alerts. Staging ACL includes the two CIDRs. Will push prod ACL after CS confirms signed doc.
Olu (Security): HSM-backed signing is doable; we'll scope the token to the two /32s, model=v3-compact, expires=2026-04-13T21:30:00Z, retention=0, debug=false. Require signed AUP + quick security addendum. Also suggest disabling request bodies in logs and masking any PII. Opening SEC ticket SEC-9207.
Rina (CS): Sending AUP + one-page security addendum to Shaan now. Shaan, can you sign and return by EOD today so we can issue token 24h before demo? Sales flagged this account as "renewal at risk"  they want a high-quality demo.
Shaan (TritonAI): We'll sign today. Quick follow-up: can you carve out a tenant-isolated pool so demo traffic doesn't share cache layers with prod traffic?
Pri (Eng Infra): Yes  tenant pinning plus isolated cache namespace for that route. Adding config snippet for staging (will apply to prod after sign-off):
```json
{"tenant":"triton","primary_region":"ap-south-1","fallback":"ap-southeast-1","allowlist":["203.0.113.142/32","198.51.100.214/32"],"cors":["https://demo.triton.ai"],"qps_limit":500,"token_constraints":{"model":"v3-compact","retention":0,"hsm_signing":true}}
```
deploy-bot: Route request queued: route-triton-ap-south-1 at 6141592658 by Bea (SRE)  status: queued
Bea (SRE): I'll monitor the demo window; alerts set for cpu>72%, p95 latency>700ms, error-rate>0.5%. If thresholds trip I'll scale to max and notify. Ping #eng-sre during the session and I'll be online.
Rina (CS): Thanks team. Once Shaan uploads signed AUP I'll confirm prod ACL push and hand over the scoped HSM-signed demo key. Shaan, good luck with the demo and please feedback outcomes to sales for the renewal motion.
